bounds.domain: One request, three abstract accumulated-body increments, retained cap of two, responses 200/413 and a peer-abort flag. IPC framing separately covers zero or positive serialized bytes and absent, explicit length, explicit zero or chunked headers.
bounds.scope: Finite safety projection; no progress/fairness claim. IPC progress assumes fair preparation and body read; real scheduling receipt checks use string, object and UTF-8 Buffer inputs. Arbitrary transport fragmentation, malformed explicit length and native device execution remain outside this projection.

assumptions: Weak fairness of serialization preparation and the legacy body read. Both are local operations; no provider success is assumed.
No fairness. The request can remain unprepared or unread.
